This is the full trace, in the 5 priority sources requested.

prior_avg_round_score_to_par.canonical_source: src/klpga/backtest/point_in_time_features.py (module docstring, verified by direct reading, not inferred from name)
prior_avg_round_score_to_par.formula: sum(player_event.score_to_par) / sum(player_event.rounds_played), over every OTHER event strictly before the target tournament's effective start date -- a rounds-weighted per-round rate in STROKES-TO-PAR units (negative = under par = good), never an average of per-event totals.
prior_avg_round_score_to_par.lookback_window: unbounded -- every prior event for the player, weighted by rounds_played
prior_avg_round_score_to_par.cutoff_semantics: temporal.is_strictly_before(event_date, target_effective_start_date); the target event's own rows are never included regardless of date
prior_avg_round_score_to_par.leakage_risk: none by construction -- this is exactly the module this whole project relies on to prevent leakage (tests/test_point_in_time_features.py is the mandatory adversarial test suite for it)

neo_consistency_stddev.formula: population standard deviation of a player's per-event scoring outcomes (same prior_events restriction as above)
